canonical_project: Eco Delta City green data center cluster / Data Center Opportunity Development Zone (Myeongji-dong)
owner: Busan Eco Delta Green DC PFV; Empyrion DC consortium; BEP & Mirae Asset consortium; Ellis Group
notes: City-designated green data center cluster on a 177,080 sqm data-industry site in Eco Delta City, Gangseo-gu (Myeongji-dong). Feb 2024 MOU with 4 anchor investors (~KRW 3.6 trillion, ~5 green DCs); Feb 2026: 1.22M sqm of Eco Delta City designated a Data Center Opportunity Development Zone (14 firms, KRW 5.36 trillion, 500 MW-scale shared receiving substation). KEPCO building a 1,000 MW substation in Gangseo-gu (2027). Cluster full-operation capacity up to ~360 MW.
